name: Enterprise Risk Assessment and Control Reliance

conditionalReferences.condition: written occupancy crosswalk against WM-ACT-033 and WM-XCT-027

constraintRules.text: WM-KNW-015 remains the Risk / Opportunity identity master; assessment context has no identity or lifecycle independent of its host and pinned risk revision.

WM-XCT-027 context pins risk revision, taxonomy, scope, exclusions, scale, expression mode, case basis, criteria version, method and technique versions, horizon, as-of, recorded and valid-until times.
Comparability requires matching or traceably converted EP-02 pins and returns comparable, comparable-with-caveats or not-comparable plus mismatched-pin list.
Aggregation requires explicit comparability and aggregation-eligibility verdicts; caveats travel and qualitative, ordinal and scenario modes prohibit difference, product and mean.
Withdrawn criteria follow declared superseded-criteria handling and are never silently re-scored.
Inherent and residual are distinct; residual cites current effectiveness, changed dimension, direction and explanation, and computes magnitude only when expression mode permits.

WM-XCT-027 excludes control catalogue binding, objective classification, applicability, accountability, design, implementation, cadence, evidence, effectiveness, crosswalk and coverage-dependency authoring.
Risk-to-control link records are contained by one host context; residual contribution is an assessment-authored claim while attribution status is risk-owner-held.
Effectiveness determination mastership remains unowned pending the WM-ACT-034/033/027 crosswalk; profile citations cannot create that master.
Effectiveness requires population, period, mechanism, method, evidence-chain digests, confidence, conclusion time, validity and invalidation triggers.
Missing, expired or invalidated effectiveness is unknown at assessment as-of time and cannot justify adverse reduction or beneficial uplift.
A failed execution affects only contexts whose population, period, mechanism and evidence chain match; other linked risks do not change automatically.
Event, observation/as-of and record time are distinct; backdated correction and retroactive amendment are distinct append-only acts.
A superseded risk or control revision marks its binding stale through an explicit named detection event; history is never rewritten.
Evidence references resolve to matching digests; missing or mismatched evidence invalidates the determination, while lawful retention or destruction is recorded without falsifying history.
Shared cause means same source, predisposing condition, held-fixed context condition, relied-on control or dependency; it creates caveats and no arithmetic permission.
WM-KNW-015 may hold response option, rationale and treatment-plan reference; this profile authors no treatment plan, milestone, execution or closure.
Residual acceptance requires an external decision with authority, threshold-table version and authorization time; acceptance does not close risk.
WM-ACT-034 is reference-only until the written occupancy crosswalk makes population, period, mechanism, evidence chain and design-versus-operation mandatory.
A completed test or assessment never implies implementation, residual closure, acceptance or treatment completion.

retainInContext: criteria, method, technique and expression pins

holds: Control has no registry allocation; no identifier is guessed.
WM-KNW-015 and WM-XCT-027 are non-canonical single-provider reviewable drafts.
WM-KNW-015 current-estimate overlap and WM-XCT-027 status:split require ratified field-level mastership cuts.
WM-ACT-034 profiling is conditional on a written occupancy crosswalk against WM-ACT-033 and WM-XCT-027.
EM-RSK-02 scope was provider-verified from public metadata but was not frozen in the original dossier; treatment mastership remains unsettled.
The contour candidate list still names Risk Treatment and Control Execution while this revision externalizes both.
Primary-source pins, approved relations, upstream staleness implementation, rights, package conversion and live conformance remain pending.
publicationStatement: Research candidate only; not canonically publishable, installable or verified.
